electric-vehicles.lead: Tungsten imports two BYD battery electric models: the Yuan Up, offered in three trims with 301 to 401 km of combined range, and the 2025 Tang L.

facts.label: Vehicles
facts.value: BYD Yuan Up and BYD Tang L (2025)

blocks.title: The Yuan Up
blocks.body: A battery electric SUV launched on 26 March 2024, sold in three trims: 301 km Lingxian, 401 km Lingxian and 401 km Chaoyue. Five seats; 4,310 by 1,830 by 1,675 mm, on a 2,620 mm wheelbase.

blocks.title: Battery and charging
blocks.body: Every trim uses BYD’s Blade Battery, 32 kWh on the 301 km trim and 45.12 kWh on the two 401 km trims. A 400-volt architecture supports AC and DC fast charging, taking the battery from 30 to 80 per cent in 30 minutes.

blocks.title: Performance
blocks.body: An AC permanent magnet synchronous motor rated 70 kW and 180 Nm, or 130 kW and 290 Nm on the 401 km trims. Acceleration from 0 to 100 km/h takes 12 seconds, or 7.9 seconds on the higher-powered trims.

blocks.title: The Tang L
blocks.body: A 2025 BYD battery electric model, imported alongside the Yuan Up. Trims, range and battery specifications are confirmed on enquiry.

blocks.title: The manufacturer
blocks.body: BYD works across electronics, automotives, renewable energy and rail transit, with more than 30 industrial parks across six continents and a focus on energy generation and storage. Vehicles are imported through Tungsten.

medical-equipment.lead: An EFDA-licensed importer that supplies, installs and maintains hospital equipment across Ethiopia, with a dedicated regulatory team handling clearance and in-house biomedical engineers handling commissioning and long-term service.

facts.label: Standards verified
facts.value: CE marking, FDA clearance or equivalent

blocks.title: Regulatory clearance
blocks.body: Imports of medical devices into Ethiopia fall under EFDA directives that classify products by risk. The regulatory team handles device classification and registration, pre-import approval of purchase orders and port-clearance permits, verification of CE marking or FDA clearance, and compliance with English labelling and instructions-for-use requirements.

blocks.title: What is supplied
blocks.body: Diagnostic imaging (digital X-ray, ultrasound, CT, MRI); critical and perioperative care (ventilators, anaesthesia machines, patient monitors, defibrillators, infusion pumps); laboratory and point-of-care analysers, PCR equipment and rapid test kits; hospital infrastructure (electric beds, operating tables, surgical lights, sterilisation units); consumables and specialty devices such as dialysis machines, neonatal incubators and oxygen concentrators.

blocks.title: Installation and service
blocks.body: In-house biomedical engineers based in Ethiopia carry out pre-installation site assessment, installation, calibration and performance verification, and training for medical and technical staff. After-sales cover includes warranty management, service contracts, preventive maintenance visits, emergency repair call-outs, and supply of genuine spare parts and consumables.

blocks.title: Procurement and delivery
blocks.body: Incoterm-based sourcing from OEMs and authorised distributors, with marine or air insurance, secure packaging, customs clearance and inland transport to any hospital site in Ethiopia. Turnkey project management covers complete hospital outfitting, backed by a record of equipping public and private hospitals.

medical-equipment.cta: Request a quotation, technical specification or feasibility consultation.

human-medicine.lead: Licensed by the Ethiopian Food and Drug Authority as an importer and wholesale distributor supplying hospitals, pharmacies and health programmes across Ethiopia with medicines from WHO-GMP-certified manufacturers.

blocks.title: Regulatory pathway
blocks.body: Every medicine comes from an EFDA-approved source, with pre-import permits and product registrations secured before shipment. The team handles the full compliance lifecycle: CTD-format dossiers, product registration and variation management, and post-market pharmacovigilance against national and international safety standards.

blocks.title: Sourcing and quality
blocks.body: Supply comes only from manufacturers holding current WHO Good Manufacturing Practice certification. Every consignment carries a batch-analysis certificate, with random third-party laboratory verification and continuous stability monitoring where required. Therapeutic classes span anti-infectives, cardiovascular agents, anti-diabetics, oncology therapies, antiretrovirals, vaccines and OTC products.

blocks.title: Cold chain
blocks.body: For vaccines, biologics and insulin, a validated cold chain runs from manufacturer to final delivery: active and passive temperature-controlled packaging, real-time data loggers giving a complete audit trail, bonded cold storage at the Addis Ababa warehouse, and specialist handling for Category A and B products.

blocks.title: Nationwide distribution
blocks.body: Central warehousing and partner logistics providers serve registered hospitals, clinics, pharmacies and government health programmes. Delivery runs within 24 hours in Addis Ababa and 48-72 hours to major regional centres, in volumes from a single carton to full-container loads.

human-medicine.cta: Contact us about specific therapeutic categories

building-glass.lead: Tungsten supplies building and housing glass — float, sheet, figured, mirror, safety and specialty — and the machines to cut, temper and finish it, from one import source.

facts.label: Flat glass
facts.value: Float, sheet, figured; clear or tinted

facts.label: Specialty glass
facts.value: Reflective, ultra-clear, louver, art, glass block

facts.label: Machinery
facts.value: Cutting, bending, tempering, edging, laminating, tinting

blocks.title: Flat glass and mirrors
blocks.body: Float, sheet and figured glass, each in clear and tinted grades. The mirror lines run from aluminium mirror on both sheet and float glass through to silver, processed and tinted mirror.

blocks.title: Safety and specialty grades
blocks.body: Laminated, tempered and wired safety glass, alongside reflective glass, ultra-clear glass, louver glass, art glass and glass block. Confirm type, thickness and dimensions when you enquire.

blocks.title: Processing machinery
blocks.body: Individual machines and complete sets for glass cutting, bending, tempering, edging, laminating and tinting. A processor can source the raw glass and the equipment to work it through the same supplier rather than splitting the order.

building-glass.cta: Send an enquiry for glass or processing machinery.

elevator-and-escalator.lead: Supply, installation, modernisation and maintenance of passenger lifts for residential and commercial buildings, with safety systems said to meet industry standards and regulations.

blocks.title: Supply through to upkeep
blocks.body: New passenger lifts supplied and installed, existing systems modernised, and maintenance offered. The page sets out no maintenance terms, contract length or response time, so treat cover as something to agree separately.

blocks.title: Safety and compliance
blocks.body: Lifts are fitted with emergency brakes, fire-resistant materials and surveillance, and are stated to comply with industry standards and regulations. No specific standard is named on the page, so ask for the certification your building requires.

blocks.title: Before you enquire
blocks.body: The page gives one contact number and no other detail. Worth confirming on the call: whether escalators are supplied at all, the makes available, delivery time and the safety certification your building requires.

calcium-hypochlorite.lead: Tungsten Import Export is currently importing calcium hypochlorite, the active ingredient in commercial bleaching powder, used for water treatment, drinking-water disinfection and swimming-pool sanitation.

facts.label: Main uses
facts.value: Water treatment, drinking water, swimming pools

blocks.title: What it is
blocks.body: Calcium hypochlorite is the main active ingredient of commercial bleaching powder. It sanitises public swimming pools, disinfects drinking water, and is used in water treatment and as a bleaching agent.

blocks.title: Sourcing and quality
blocks.body: The material is sourced from international manufacturers. Incoming consignments are checked against the required specifications for purity, chemical composition and consistency.

blocks.title: Availability and enquiries
blocks.body: This is an incoming line and is not yet available. To discuss your specific requirements or register interest, contact the sales team on +251 91 261 0248 or at info@tungstenimpex.com.

calcium-hypochlorite.cta: Contact the sales team to discuss your requirements.

plastic-raw-materials.lead: Tungsten Import Export imports plastic raw materials and master batch, and is looking for recycled and virgin HDPE from a reliable long-term source.

blocks.title: What we import
blocks.body: Tungsten imports plastic raw materials and master batch, and also imports and distributes industrial raw materials. It is looking for recycled HDPE in injection and blow grades, in various colours, and for HDPE in injection and crate grade, virgin material included.

blocks.title: What to quote
blocks.body: Suppliers should list the material available at present, stating colour, whether it is pelletised, and whether it is crushed and washed. Quality and consistency matter above all.

blocks.title: Long-term supply
blocks.body: Tungsten is looking for a reliable source for a lasting supply relationship, and asks interested suppliers to reply promptly.

solar-lanterns.lead: Tungsten imports and distributes quality-approved units for off-grid rural households, replacing kerosene lamps and candles with light that also charges phones and runs small electronics.

blocks.title: Off-grid lighting
blocks.body: The lanterns replace kerosene lamps and candles, and power lights, mobile phones, televisions, fans and other small electronic devices. They run on solar energy alone and draw nothing from the grid, so they keep working through brownouts and blackouts.

blocks.title: Rural use
blocks.body: They are aimed at farming households beyond the grid, for lighting in the home and for charging mobile phones. Tungsten works in these rural areas.

blocks.title: Import and distribution
blocks.body: Tungsten imports the lanterns and distributes them itself, so import and local distribution sit with one company. The units imported are quality approved.

solar-lanterns.cta: Send an inquiry for specifications, quantities and delivery terms.

niger-seed-noug.lead: Pressed in Ethiopia for edible cooking oil, this oilseed passed coffee among the country’s US exports in 2002 and now accounts for a third of them.

facts.label: US export share
facts.value: One third of Ethiopia’s to America

facts.label: Other export lines
facts.value: Sesame, soya bean, red kidney beans

blocks.title: What noug is
blocks.body: Noug is the Ethiopian name for niger seed. Ethiopia uses it for oil extraction for human consumption as cooking oil, which puts oilseed crushers and edible-oil processors at the center of the buyer list.

blocks.title: Position in the US trade
blocks.body: Niger seed exports passed coffee exports to the United States in 2002 and account for a third of Ethiopia’s exports to America. That marks an established export flow from origin rather than a thin or occasional trade.

blocks.title: The exporter
blocks.body: Tungsten Import Export runs a parallel oilseed and pulse line: sesame seed, soya bean and red kidney beans. Its leading shareholder holds an MBA from Mekelle University and more than twenty years’ export experience in international business and import and export supply-chain management.

blocks.title: Before you inquire
blocks.body: No grade, moisture, purity, packing or shipment specification is published here. Send your destination market and required volume, state any specification you work to, and ask for export documentation and trade references before you commit.

niger-seed-noug.cta: Send an inquiry with your destination, volume and specification.

sesame-seed.lead: Buyers choose between three well-known Ethiopian sesame varieties: Humera and Gonder for bakery products, Wellega for its high oil content.

blocks.title: Origin and varieties
blocks.body: Ethiopia grows a large number of sesame varieties. Three are well known: Humera, Gonder and Wellega.

blocks.title: For bakery use
blocks.body: The Humera variety is appreciated worldwide for its aroma and sweet taste, and is suitable for a range of bakery products. The Gonder type is likewise suited to the bakery market.

blocks.title: For oil content
blocks.body: The high oil content of the Wellega type is named as its main advantage.

blocks.title: Specifying an enquiry
blocks.body: The three varieties are described differently, so name the one you want. Quantity and destination are worth stating in the same message.

sesame-seed.cta: Enquire, naming the variety, quantity and destination.

red-kidney-beans.lead: Grown in Ethiopia and known locally as Qey Boloqe, these red kidney beans are popular across Scandinavia, Germany and wider Europe, and in India and Pakistan.

blocks.title: Where it’s popular
blocks.body: The variety is popular in Scandinavian and wider European markets, Germany among them, and in South Asia, notably India and Pakistan. The source describes demand for the bean, not Tungsten’s own shipments, so ask the company which of these markets it currently supplies.

blocks.title: In the kitchen
blocks.body: Buyers use them for Rajma and other traditional dishes, and in salads, rice, pasta and stews.

blocks.title: The exporter
blocks.body: Tungsten Import Export trades in both directions from Ethiopia, exporting red kidney beans alongside niger seed (noug), sesame seed and soya bean. The leading shareholder holds an MBA from Mekelle University and more than 20 years of export experience.

blocks.title: Specification and terms
blocks.body: Grade, moisture, packing and shipment terms are not stated here and are agreed with the company on enquiry. Request a current sample measured against your own market’s requirements before committing.

red-kidney-beans.cta: Contact Tungsten Import Export to request a sample and terms.

soya-bean.lead: A legume native to East Asia, grown for its edible bean and processed into soy milk, tofu and fermented foods — one of four Tungsten export lines.

facts.label: Fermented uses
facts.value: Soy sauce, bean paste, nattō, tempeh

blocks.title: From bean to product
blocks.body: The unfermented route runs through soy milk, from which tofu and tofu skin are made. Fermented soya foods include soy sauce, fermented bean paste, nattō and tempeh.

blocks.title: Where it sits
blocks.body: Tungsten Import Export offers soya bean alongside sesame seed, niger seed (noug) and red kidney beans. The company states more than 20 years of export experience.

blocks.title: Before you enquire
blocks.body: Grade, packing, volume and delivery terms are not published here; they are settled enquiry by enquiry. Stating your destination market, required volume and specification lets the company respond against your actual requirement.

soya-bean.cta: Send an enquiry with your market, volume and specification.
